budget.decision: Budget enlargement and fresh-source counts were authorized independently before reading first-study qualification results; retain and report both studies in full.
budget.primary_checkpoint_selection: Compare 8 and 64 updates only on original development CE; report every checkpoint on fresh qualification.

semantic_observer.qualifier: These linear source-trained observers are a calibration guard, not validated general natural-semantic judges.

limitations: Participant identity is unavailable; video-source separation is not participant separation.
Size-bounded source subset is not representative of all natural video.
Captions are templated action/sound annotations, not open-domain fluent narration.
Qualification annotations are read only to freeze event windows; qualification media and metrics are not used for fitting or selection.
All sources are from the official train split; these are new project-level partitions, not official benchmark results.
Both studies are reported; new holdouts exclude all 64 original videos, but participant identity separation is not verified.
One neural training seed; source-cluster intervals do not quantify training-seed uncertainty.
Fixed architecture CPU timing is treated as conditionally exogenous; parameter derivatives of platform timing are not estimated.
The 5-to-7 candidate actor extension has a new continuation hash; prior 8-step checkpoint training identities are preserved by explicit migration.
The original eight-update actor used precomputed public features; this expansion charges the online actor/NN feature computation.
Four emitted media formats and high reconstruction similarity do not establish open-domain or natural semantic generation.
The natural shared-state model extends the research NeuralPortfolio convention; it is not the native owner binary integrated by the separate runtime work package.
